name: Mono-101
author: sd88me
summary: A circuit-modelled SH-101-style mono synth: a port of the Lemus engine, which solves the original schematic part by part, modified for the MPC. The manual's 40 sample sounds, user presets named on screen, and a Circuit Bent page (PWM sources, triangle VCO, overdrive, VCF FM, LFO range, key trigger and tempo sync). Gen2 (aarch64) only.
